items.title: Holy Coin Cells!!! Quantity REALLY Matters! But WHY???
items.description: Apparently there's a threshold where coin cell batteries are far more likely to rupture. Not a single battery out of 250 burst after two days, but 1250 started popping in minutes. Yet individuals in the comments claim experiencing single battery shorts that burned or exploded. Do I need to experiment shorting hundreds of individual batteries until one of them pops?

items.title: CR2032 Batteries Can Spontaneously Burst!
items.description: It was hard to find pics of this online and even harder to make them do it on command. But turns out with the right conditions, CR2032s really can rupture spontaneously. Also most of the disposal containers on Amazon are plastic! Every battery disposal container I've seen in industry is metal, yet that's not what's most widely available. LEARN from my oversight/near-miss and use a metal bucket with a lid!
